name: hollywood-animal-master
description: Movie Distribution Calculator for Hollywood Animal game

scripts.sync-version: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const v=fs.readFileSync('gradle.properties','utf8').match(/project\.version=(.+)/)[1].trim(); const pkg=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('package.json','utf8')); pkg.version=v; fs.writeFileSync('package.json', JSON.stringify(pkg,null,2)+'\n');"
